java.lang.Object

All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, AutoCloseable, POITextExtractor, POIXMLTextExtractor, ExcelExtractor
public class XSSFBEventBasedExcelExtractor extends XSSFEventBasedExcelExtractor
Implementation of a text extractor or xlsb Excel files that uses SAX-like binary parsing.

    • setHandleHyperlinksInCells

      public void setHandleHyperlinksInCells(boolean handleHyperlinksInCells)
      Should the targets of the hyperlinks be added to the text of the cells they cover? The target is appended to the cell text as " <target>", which is the url for external links and the location (e.g. Sheet2!A1) for links within the workbook. Default is false.
      Parameters:
      handleHyperlinksInCells - true to add the hyperlink targets
